# Junior Reactive

> AI and IT solutions company based in Kampala, Uganda, serving businesses across East Africa. Builds N8N automations, AI assistants, custom software, cloud infrastructure, and data analytics under fixed-scope, fixed-price engagements. Founded by Pharrell Aaron Mugumya.

Junior Reactive works with East African businesses that want practical, working technology rather than open-ended consulting. Every engagement starts with a fixed scope and price, and clients own the full deliverable - source code, documentation, and deployment access - at handover.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://juniorreactive.com/services): all nine service lines, each with a fixed scope and quote
- [AI Consulting](https://juniorreactive.com/services/ai-consulting): strategic AI roadmaps tied to concrete business outcomes
- [N8N Workflow Automation](https://juniorreactive.com/services): connecting existing tools and automating repetitive processes
- [Custom Software Development](https://juniorreactive.com/services): bespoke software built around a business's actual workflows
- [Cloud Solutions](https://juniorreactive.com/services): secure, cost-efficient cloud infrastructure
- [Data Analytics & Insights](https://juniorreactive.com/services): turning raw data into decisions
- [AI Courses & Training](https://juniorreactive.com/services): practical AI education for teams
